title: Scrap Dealer
flavor_text: A tinkerer eyes your spare parts and rattles a coin purse.

title: Wandering Merchant
flavor_text: A hooded trader unfurls a dusty satchel of wares.

title: Blood Altar
flavor_text: A crimson altar hums softly. It demands a sacrifice.

title: Depot Assault
flavor_text: Scouts report a heavily defended depot. Clear it out for a scrap bonus.

title: Locked Cache
flavor_text: Two sealed caches appear on your charts. You can only claim one.

title: Hidden Supplies
flavor_text: Rumors mark three quiet stockpiles. Each holds a little spare scrap.

title: Depot Cleared
flavor_text: The depot falls. Salvage crews haul out spare components.

title: Component Cache
flavor_text: You crack the component cache and pocket the haul.

title: Gold Cache
flavor_text: You crack the gold cache and pocket the haul.

title: Hidden Stockpile
flavor_text: You uncover a small stash of spare components.
